channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Ahead of Nvidia's first results without Jensen Huang on Tuesday, the weekend's clearest signal was that a granted grid connection now trades on its own. In Spain, Box2Bit dropped its last Aragon project after Red Electrica denied substation access elsewhere and sold the 150 MW connection it did hold to Blackstone, whose Calatorao campus already has planning permission for 430 MW. In Canada, Telus pulled out of two Vancouver AI data centres that had 85 MW of BC Hydro power behind them, after local protests and a council change; Westbank says a new partner will continue. Capital kept flowing to places that can deliver power: AirTrunk signed an MoU for 1.8 GW near Visakhapatnam, Digital Realty told Nikkei it will spend $10 billion to take Japan from 193 MW to about 700 MW, and Core Scientific filed a $1.3 billion building in Hunt County, Texas, where AMD is set to lease 110 MW. List prices held for a sixth straight day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.

item.title: Compute brief - 16 November 2026
item.description: Ahead of Nvidia's first results without Jensen Huang on Tuesday, the weekend's clearest signal was that a granted grid connection now trades on its own. In Spain, Box2Bit dropped its last Aragon project after Red Electrica denied substation access elsewhere and sold the 150 MW connection it did hold to Blackstone, whose Calatorao campus already has planning permission for 430 MW. In Canada, Telus pulled out of two Vancouver AI data centres that had 85 MW of BC Hydro power behind them, after local protests and a council change; Westbank says a new partner will continue. Capital kept flowing to places that can deliver power: AirTrunk signed an MoU for 1.8 GW near Visakhapatnam, Digital Realty told Nikkei it will spend $10 billion to take Japan from 193 MW to about 700 MW, and Core Scientific filed a $1.3 billion building in Hunt County, Texas, where AMD is set to lease 110 MW. List prices held for a sixth straight day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69. Countries: Spain: Box2Bit exits Epila and sells its 150 MW grid connection to Blackstone's Calatorao campus (Wire, 16 Nov, single-source). India: AirTrunk MoU with Andhra Pradesh for 400 MW at Rambilli and 1.4 GW at Tootipala (Wire, 14 Nov, confirmed, MoU). Japan: Digital Realty and Mitsubishi plan $10 billion over a decade, 193 MW to about 700 MW (Wire, 14 Nov, corroborated, CEO interview). Canada: Telus exits Westbank's two Vancouver AI data centres; Westbank continues with an unnamed partner (Wire, 14 Nov, corroborated). United States: Core Scientific files $1.3 billion Hunt County building; AMD set to lease 110 MW; bitcoin mining exit by year-end (Wire, 16 Nov, confirmed).
